tools.name: facebook_download_links
tools.description: Get direct download links for a public Facebook video, reel, watch link, share link or photo post: SD and HD MP4 with audio, separate video/audio tracks, thumbnail, title and duration.

tools.name: tiktok_download_links
tools.description: Get no-watermark MP4 links (HD original quality and SD, with file sizes), every image of a photo post or slideshow, the music track, cover image, title and author for a public TikTok post.

tools.name: pinterest_download_links
tools.description: Get download links for the videos, images and GIFs of a public Pinterest pin or Idea Pin (pinterest.com or pin.it short links).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links · Private data: tiktok_download_links · Public sink: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links · Private data: tiktok_download_links · Public sink: facebook_download_links, tiktok_download_links

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "tiktok_download_links" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get no-watermark MP4 links (HD and SD), the music track, cover image, title and author for a public TikTok video." → after: "Get no-watermark MP4 links (HD original quality and SD, with file sizes), every image of a photo post or slideshow, the music track, cover image, title and author for a public TikTok post."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
